label: Accessible name of the card in a chat where the person approves a page a socio (AI agent) drafted.
phase.deleted.title: Card heading: the page was saved from this review and deleted since.
phase.deleted.badge: Short status at the card's top right.
phase.conflict.title: Card heading: what was saved differs from this draft.
phase.conflict.badge: Short status at the card's top right.
phase.saved.title: Card heading: the draft was approved and saved in the Space (product noun).
phase.saved.badge: Short status at the card's top right.
phase.checking.title: Card heading while the app checks whether the draft was saved already.
phase.checking.badge: Short status at the card's top right.
phase.ended.title: Card heading: the chat moved on without a decision.
phase.ended.badge: Short status at the card's top right.
phase.invalid.title: Card heading: the socio's draft can't be saved as it is.
phase.invalid.badge: Short status at the card's top right.
phase.waiting.title: Card heading while the socio (AI agent) is still writing the draft.
phase.waiting.badge: Short status at the card's top right.
phase.ready.title: Card heading: the person may approve or decline the draft.
phase.ready.badge: Short status at the card's top right: the person decides.
preparing: In place of the draft's title while it is being written.
untitled: In place of the title of a draft that has none.
invalid: Error on the card. {{problem}} is what's wrong with the draft, in English from the app (not translated yet).
retry: Button that checks the review's state again after an error.
continue: Button after saving that lets the socio (AI agent) carry on in the chat.
approve: Button that approves the draft and saves it as a page.
send-back: Button that returns a draft that can't be saved to the socio (AI agent) to fix.
decline: Button that declines the draft; nothing is saved.
hint.waiting: Note on the card while it waits; "any review above it" is an earlier card in the same chat.
